w5chat_template_intro: Rewrite the title and the body of this channel's messages. Leave a field empty to keep the usual text.
w5chat_template_format_plain: Plain text: values are inserted as they are.
w5chat_template_format_slack: Slack formatting: *bold*, _italics_ and links. Values are escaped, so a device name cannot add formatting.
w5chat_template_format_html: Email: the message is HTML, the subject plain text. Values are escaped.
w5chat_template_format_telegram: Telegram MarkdownV2: *bold*, _italics_, [text](address). Put a backslash before ( ) [ ] * _ ~ | > when you mean the character itself; full stops, dashes and values are escaped for you.
w5chat_template_variables_help: Inserts the variable where the cursor is. Any device tag works too, for example tags.room.
w5chat_template_preview_note: As the service receives it, before it applies the formatting.
w5chat_interactive_slack_url_help: In your Slack app, open Interactivity & Shortcuts, turn it on and paste this address as the Request URL.
w5chat_interactive_telegram_url_help: DumbMonit registered this address as the bot's webhook when you saved the channel.
w5chat_interactive_no_public_url: Interactive buttons need the instance's public URL, in https (Notification policy). Until then, messages keep their links.
w5chat_interactive_after_save_slack: Save the channel to get the address to paste in your Slack app.
w5chat_interactive_after_save_telegram: Save the channel: DumbMonit then registers itself as the bot's webhook.
